scientific_integrity: The same spectral exponent and geometric-spectrum idea are known for continuous gradient flow. The contribution assessed here is the arbitrary-radius discrete ball-proximal theorem. Self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional symmetric positive-definite quadratics and exact Euclidean ball-oracle steps only. The multiplicative bounds are not claimed optimal; the order lower bound holds on a geometric-spectrum family in the small-radius limit.
title: Spectral-band path length for quadratic ball-proximal optimization
